post.summary: Register an ordinary CUSTOMER; caller cannot select a role

201.description: AuthUserResponse CUSTOMER/PENDING_VERIFICATION; no session or password returned

400.description: Invalid/unknown fields including requestedRole and role

get.summary: Read own upgrade prerequisites without contacting asset provider

200.description: {role, identityVerified, assetServiceAvailable, version}; no-store; no M2M credentials/asset list

post.summary: Explicitly consent, check linked Auth0 assets server-side, and upgrade CUSTOMER to OWNER
post.description: Requires ACTIVE ordinary account and persisted VERIFIED VNeID identity. Server reads linked subject app_metadata.vneid.assets via Management API using Backend-only credentials; needs >=1 supported owned rentable asset. Never trusts client roles, actor IDs, asset lists/counts or verification flags. Provider failure/empty data never promotes. V14 stores consent version/time and eligible count; account version/row lock guards commit; repeat for existing OWNER is idempotent. Retains exact-party rental access; no property import/publication/approval implied.

200.description: AuthUserResponse with server role OWNER; no-store; existing session remains valid

403.description: Missing CSRF, ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE, VNEID_REQUIRED, OWNER_ASSET_REQUIRED or disallowed role

503.description: ASSET_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or ASSET_SOURCE_INVALID; no role change
